name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio:
Gareth's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a childhood fascination with the physics of flight. After excelling in engineering at Cardiff University, he initially pursued a career in aerospace, working on wind tunnel testing for commercial aircraft. However, the allure of speed and competition proved too strong. He transitioned to motorsport, starting in Formula Ford before quickly climbing the ranks to Formula 3 and eventually landing a role in Formula 1.

He spent several years honing his skills in F1 and sports car racing, developing a reputation for his meticulous approach to aerodynamic design and his ability to extract performance from even the most challenging regulations. He is renowned for his deep understanding of airflow management and its impact on vehicle dynamics, and this expertise has been invaluable in his role as Head of Aero for Brad Jones Racing.

Gareth is known for his collaborative spirit and his willingness to mentor younger engineers. He believes that a strong team is essential for success in motorsport, and he fosters a culture of open communication and shared learning within his department. His ability to blend cutting-edge technology with a hands-on approach makes him a valuable asset to any team.
